invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if resource is null, so resource must always be non-null at return.
If the method returns a non-null String, it comes from findKey (likely a non-empty string name). Otherwise, result is null.
result is declared as String and comes from typeResources.findKey, which likely returns a String or null.
If there is no typeResources for the resource's class, result is null; otherwise, result may be non-null.
When the typeResources map is null, result is always null. Otherwise, result may or may not be null.
